name: redmine-get_current_user
description: Return the Redmine user that owns the supplied API key.

name: redmine-list_trackers
description: List trackers (issue types) with ids.

name: redmine-list_issue_statuses
description: List issue statuses with ids and is_closed flag.

name: redmine-list_priorities
description: List issue priorities with ids.

name: redmine-list_custom_fields
description: List custom field definitions (needs admin; otherwise 403).

name: redmine-list_projects
description:
List projects visible to the caller (paginated). `name`: substring match.
`status`: 1 active, 5 closed, 9 archived. `sort`: e.g. 'name:asc', 'created_on:desc'
(keys: id, name, identifier, status, created_on, updated_on).

name: redmine-get_project
description:
Get a project by numeric id or identifier. `include`: comma list
(trackers, issue_categories, enabled_modules, time_entry_activities).

name: redmine-list_project_members
description: List project memberships (users/groups and roles).

name: redmine-list_versions
description: List versions (milestones/sprints) of a project.

name: redmine-search_issues
description:
Search issues server-side. Every filter takes a Redmine operator expression; a bare
value means equals. Operators: '>=2026-10-01', '<=2026-10-13', '><2026-10-01|2026-10-31'
(between), '!5' (not), '5|6' (any of), '*' (any value), '!*' (no value), '~text'
(contains), 't' today, '>t-7' (after 7 days ago), '<t-0' (before today), 'w' this week,
'm' this month, 'ld' yesterday. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; note '<2026-10-13' is rejected by
Redmine for due_date, so use '<=2026-10-12' or '<t-0' for overdue.
`status`: open|closed|*|<status id>|!<id>. `assigned_to_id`, `author_id`, `watcher_id`:
id, 'me', '!me'. `custom_fields`: {"18": "BAU-1"} filters custom field 18 (cf_18).
`include`: comma list (children, attachments, relations, changesets, journals, watchers).
`sort`: comma list of key[:asc|desc]; keys: id subject status priority tracker project
category fixed_version assigned_to author parent start_date due_date estimated_hours
spent_hours done_ratio created_on updated_on closed_on last_updated_by relations, or
cf_<custom field id>. Overdue tasks of mine: due_date='<=2026-10-13', assigned_to_id='me'.

name: redmine-get_issue
description:
Get one issue. `include`: comma list of journals, children, attachments,
relations, changesets, watchers, allowed_statuses.

name: redmine-create_issue
description:
Create an issue. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. `custom_fields`: [{"id": 18, "value": "x"}].
`uploads`: [{"token", "filename", "content_type"}] from upload_attachment.

name: redmine-update_issue
description:
Update an issue; only given fields change. `notes` adds a journal comment.
`uploads`: [{"token", "filename", "content_type"}] from upload_attachment.
Returns the re-read issue.

name: redmine-add_issue_comment
description: Add a comment (journal note) to an issue.

name: redmine-delete_issue
description: Permanently delete an issue (needs delete permission).

name: redmine-create_issue_relation
description:
Link issues. relation_type: relates|duplicates|duplicated|blocks|blocked|precedes|
follows|copied_to|copied_from.

name: redmine-delete_issue_relation
description: Remove an issue relation by relation id.

name: redmine-add_watcher
description: Add a watcher to an issue.

name: redmine-list_time_entries
description:
List time entries. `user_id` may be 'me'. Dates YYYY-MM-DD. `spent_on` takes a Redmine
operator ('>=2026-10-01', '><a|b', 't-7'). `sort`: e.g. 'spent_on:desc' (keys: id,
spent_on, hours, user, project, issue, activity, comments, created_on, updated_on).

name: redmine-list_time_entry_activities
description: List time entry activities (ids for log_time).

name: redmine-log_time
description: Log spent time on an issue or project (one of issue_id/project_id required).

name: redmine-list_users
description:
List/search users by name or login (needs admin; non-admins get 403 - then use
list_project_members). `status`: 1 active, 2 registered, 3 locked. `sort`: e.g.
'lastname:asc' (keys: id, login, firstname, lastname, mail, admin, status, created_on,
last_login_on).

name: redmine-search
description:
Full-text search across issues, wiki, news, etc.; results come ranked by relevance
(Redmine ignores `sort` here). `scope`: 'all' (default), 'my_projects', 'subprojects'.
`titles_only`: match titles only. `all_words=false`: match ANY word instead of all words.
`open_issues`: skip closed issues. Object types: set one or more of issues, wiki_pages,
news, documents, changesets, messages, projects to restrict the result types (none set =
all types). `attachments`: '0' none, '1' also search attachments, 'only' only
attachments.

name: redmine-list_wiki_pages
description: List wiki pages of a project.

name: redmine-get_wiki_page
description: Read a wiki page (optionally a historical version).

name: redmine-upsert_wiki_page
description:
Create or overwrite a wiki page. Read it first and verify afterwards.
`uploads`: [{"token", "filename", "content_type"}] from upload_attachment.

name: redmine-remove_watcher
description: Remove a watcher from an issue.

name: redmine-list_issue_relations
description: List relations of an issue.

name: redmine-get_issue_relation
description: Get one relation by relation id.

name: redmine-get_time_entry
description: Get one time entry.

name: redmine-update_time_entry
description: Update a time entry; only given fields change. Returns the re-read entry.

name: redmine-delete_time_entry
description: Delete a time entry.

name: redmine-delete_wiki_page
description: Delete a wiki page (and its history).

name: redmine-upload_attachment
description:
Upload a file and return {token, filename, content_type}. Pass that object in `uploads`
of create_issue / update_issue / upsert_wiki_page, or to upload_project_file.

content_base64.description: Standard padded base64 of the file bytes, no line breaks.
content_base64.title: Content Base64

name: redmine-get_attachment
description: Get attachment metadata (filename, size, author, content_url).

name: redmine-download_attachment
description: Download an attachment as base64 (refused above MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES).

name: redmine-update_attachment
description: Rename / re-describe an attachment (Redmine >= 5.1). Returns the re-read metadata.

name: redmine-delete_attachment
description: Delete an attachment.

name: redmine-list_project_files
description: List files in a project's Files module.

name: redmine-upload_project_file
description: Publish an uploaded file (token from upload_attachment) into the project's Files.

name: redmine-list_issue_categories
description: List issue categories of a project.

name: redmine-get_issue_category
description: Get one issue category.

name: redmine-create_issue_category
description: Create an issue category in a project.

name: redmine-update_issue_category
description: Update an issue category. Returns the re-read category.

name: redmine-delete_issue_category
description:
Delete an issue category; `reassign_to_id` moves its issues to another category
(otherwise they become uncategorised).

name: redmine-get_version
description: Get one version (milestone).

name: redmine-create_version
description:
Create a version. status: open|locked|closed. sharing: none|descendants|hierarchy|
tree|system. due_date YYYY-MM-DD.

name: redmine-update_version
description: Update a version; only given fields change. Returns the re-read version.

name: redmine-delete_version
description: Delete a version (fails with 422 if issues still use it).

name: redmine-get_membership
description: Get one project membership.

name: redmine-create_membership
description: Add a user (or group) to a project with the given role ids.

name: redmine-update_membership
description: Replace the roles of a membership. Returns the re-read membership.

name: redmine-delete_membership
description: Remove a membership from its project.

name: redmine-create_project
description: Create a project (needs permission). `identifier`: lowercase, digits, - and _.

name: redmine-update_project
description: Update a project; only given fields change. Returns the re-read project.
